meta: What is a system prompt? The same AI answers briefly in one app and at length in another. The reason is the system prompt, a hidden instruction.

muc.title: Every app has its own style
muc.text: The same AI is brief in one app and wordy in another. The reason is the system prompt.

muc.title: Instructions before you type
muc.text: A system prompt is a hidden instruction the app gives the AI, read even before your first message.

muc.title: Role, tone, limits
muc.text: It usually covers the role, the tone of voice, what it may do and what it must refuse.

muc.title: Your own instructions
muc.text: Many chatbots let you write your own instructions, like a small system prompt applied to every chat.

muc.title: Three lines up front
muc.text: Open your chatbot's settings and write three lines about yourself and how you want it to answer.

thu: Open your chatbot's settings and write three lines about yourself and how you want it to answer.
